name: lpx-conversation-board
description: A local conversation organizer with project filters, topic boards, workflow status, and a timeline.

chatAtlas.codexHome.description: Codex data folder. Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

chatAtlas.claudeHome.description: Claude Code data folder. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

chatAtlas.maxSessions.description: Maximum recent local conversations to index per provider.

chatAtlas.refreshSeconds.description: Refresh interval while the board is open.

chatAtlas.runningTimeoutMinutes.description: Hide the running indicator after this many minutes without task activity. Increase it for long tools or builds. Completion and interruption records stop the indicator immediately.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/providers.js && node --check media/board.js && node --check media/projects.js && node --check scripts/preview.js && node --check scripts/package.js
